sdk_source_and_operation_rows.operations: Axis products with sine and one-minus-cosine form a rotation matrix before the combine-mode dispatch.
Combine modes scale components versus basis vectors, or construct the replacement diagonal.
Combine modes add translation directly, multiply it by the basis, or set identity and translation.
Combine modes swap the matrix-product operands or copy the replacement matrix.
Modes 1 and 2 store projection, conditionally update the frame and update depth. An invalid mode reports an error and returns null.
Two operand orders in both rotate and transform call the same affine product. The callee combines four vector rows and intersects input flags.
Projection updates its parent frame. The callee links a clean root into the dirty list and sets root and subtree flags.
Projection changes recompute the two depth coefficients from near and far planes using reciprocal depth in perspective mode.
The device callback runs first. Six fallback requests select count, name, current and selected subsystem or finalization defaults.

0diax/diax-mkarmageddon.native_scope: The upstream wrapper applies host aspect/FOV overrides and translates Xbox NV2A commands to D3D11. Its generated game code and claimed gameplay have no native-port credit.
0diax/diax-mkarmageddon.video_setup: Function 002695f0 calls 002a37cb (catalogued as XGetVideoFlags). Flag 0x02 takes precedence and writes 1280x720. Otherwise flag 0x01 writes 720x480. Neither flag selects 640x480. Both wide paths write aspect bits 3fe38e39 and FOV bits 42b05bf5. These are original setup branches, without a new video capture.
0diax/diax-mkarmageddon.camera: Original call 0005a59d targets 002bb870, whose field stores at +68/+6c and reciprocals at +70/+74 match the separately verified PS2 camera view-window operation.

ps2_admissions.operations: Requires a 12-byte read. Decodes the old and packed library IDs and conditionally stores type, length, version and build. The retail build output extends the 3.1 reference ABI.
Reads headers, skips the payload of each nonmatching type, then repeats. A matching type requires an unsigned version from 0x34000 through 0x36003 before length and version are returned.
Finds the extension chunk (type 3), dispatches nested chunks by registered ID or skips their payloads, subtracts each payload plus 12 bytes, then invokes registered always callbacks.
Stores both window components and their reciprocals, updates a non-null parent frame through 001a7510, and returns the camera on both branches.

ps2_stream_version.header_reader: 0019f0b0 reads 12 bytes. A zero upper half of the library ID selects the old version-shift-by-eight form with build zero. In the packed form the low halfword supplies the build. The original code decodes the observed 0x1803ffff stamp to 0x36003 and 0xffff.
ps2_stream_version.finder: 0019f1e0 admits matching-type headers with 0x34000 <= version < 0x36004. The branch-likely delay slot at 0019f244 initializes the upper limit. The finder skips unmatched payloads and rereads the header.
ps2_stream_version.registry: At 001a2bec the registry reader asks for chunk type 3. Its success-only delay slot at 001a2bf8 loads the returned version. It repeats the unsigned compatibility check, performs registered callbacks or skips payloads, and finally calls each configured always callback.
ps2_stream_version.limits: These static comparisons establish an accepted version range. They cannot determine the exact PS2 linked runtime revision, toolchain or ownership of all remaining functions.

General transform, production integration, unobserved programs and whole-game native acceptance
Contradictions with earlier documents: The SDK/library population is not a proved RenderWare ownership count; conventional names are not recovered symbols.
Historical 0409 PS2 constructor/destructor addresses use 001a...; original registration words prove 001c... addresses.
Route and census registration hashes cover different end-exclusive spans; the full census includes the return delay slot.
Component containers and GPU primitives do not establish native whole-scene drawing or remove interim GS state.
The older lower bound predates the diagnostic/registry joins. The current complement separates the proved descriptor. R192 is the active gameplay oracle in the README.
The 3.1.0.1 sample is a cross-version reference. Original Armageddon model headers identify the stream writer as 3.6.0.3.
A summed Ghidra split-body size cannot establish the full original byte interval. The material initializer required four ranges and three verified intervening words.
The three quoted Xbox addresses are raw XBE offsets. Source IDs identify compilation units. The independent PS2 finder accepts every unsigned decoded version in 0x34000..0x36003.

0019f0b0.operations: Requires a 12-byte read. Decodes the old and packed library IDs and conditionally stores type, length, version and build. The retail build output extends the 3.1 reference ABI.

0019f1e0.operations: Reads headers, skips the payload of each nonmatching type, then repeats. A matching type requires an unsigned version from 0x34000 through 0x36003 before length and version are returned.

001a2bc0.operations: Finds the extension chunk (type 3), dispatches nested chunks by registered ID or skips their payloads, subtracts each payload plus 12 bytes, then invokes registered always callbacks.

001a64a0.operations: Stores both window components and their reciprocals, updates a non-null parent frame through 001a7510, and returns the camera on both branches.

A1.rule: A blocked item halts only dependent steps. 5S depends on 6.1, 6.3 and 6.4. Per-function 7.1 depends on that function ownership and transformation. 7.2 through 7.4 are independent and may proceed immediately. Publish a stop record only after independent work is exhausted.

A2.rule: Record the vtable address, installing constructor, original factory call chain keyed by game resource tags and proof every method pointer is a text/code address. Class names are optional. Use a proved resource tag or vt_<address>, with name_source. Never invent a class name.

A3.rule: Classify every one of the pinned 226 installed-table candidates as confirmed vtable, not a vtable or unresolved. Confirmed records include constructor, factory callers, allocation size and methods. Methods reachable only through game-constructor vtables become verified-game. Other callback tables remain inferred. Completion requires disposition of all candidates; class-name gaps are limits.

A4.rule: Pin the private Ghidra listing or saved project by SHA-256 in the private-inputs manifest. A clean checkout with those inputs must regenerate ownership rows with an identical hash.

A5.rule: Stratify at least 30 rows of each inferred category, or all rows when fewer. Check sampled ownership at E1 level and report confirmed versus refuted results. Keep unsampled rows at their existing evidence level.

A6.rule: Close Step 6 after 6.1, 6.3 through 6.11, 6.13 and 6.14 are complete, with 6.2 complete or its limits recorded. Proceed to 5S and 7 under the per-function gates.

A7.rule: Keep primary oracle designation, renderer core/materials/geometry/world routes and Xbox-only content as open owner decisions in TASK_BOARD.md.

A8.rule: Name and independently hash the two files beyond the original 3256 oracle entries, and confirm both are additive launchers.

additions.contents:
@echo off
setlocal
rem Add-only oracle launcher with ALL hooks restored (MKA_HealthDeduction + 7 Kombat Practice overlay hooks + --wrap + observers + tracer + profiler + PS2_NATIVE_VERTEX).
set "REPO_ROOT=%~dp0..\Armageddon-backup\armageddon-reimplementation"
if not exist "%REPO_ROOT%\launchers\launch_oracle.ps1" (
    echo [oracle] Tracked launcher missing. Original oracle files were not changed.
    pause
    exit /b 1
)
"%SystemRoot%\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe" -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "%REPO_ROOT%\launchers\launch_oracle.ps1" -Run -Mode FullHooks %*
set "RC=%ERRORLEVEL%"
if not "%RC%"=="0" (
    echo.
    echo [oracle] Launcher exited with code %RC%.
    pause
)
exit /b %RC%
